en: FESTIVAL WALK: Negotiating the Real (Ars Electronica Festival, Linz, 2026)
zh: FESTIVAL WALK：协商真实（林茨电子艺术节，2026）
desc_en: Part of the theme exhibition of Ars Electronica 2026, 'Negotiating Humanity' (9–13 Sep 2026): a route through eight venues in Linz's OK Quarter with works on how truth claims are governed, imagined, simulated and sensed, among them a working bot farm, a robot dog steered from exile, a machine that reads visitors aloud and an AI clone that argues against its original.
desc_zh: 2026 年林茨电子艺术节主题展“协商人性”（9 月 9 日至 13 日）的一部分：一条穿过林茨 OK 街区八个场地的路线，作品讨论“真实”如何被治理、想象、模拟和感知，其中有一座可运行的水军农场、一只由流亡者远程操纵的机器狗、一台把观众“读”出来的机器，以及一个与本人辩论的 AI 克隆体。
